request.style: English, children's song, gentle female vocal with kids choir, ukulele, glockenspiel, soft piano, shaker, warm and simple, 98 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I've got a seed so very small
You can hardly see it at all
Put it in the ground and wait
God will make it grow so great

[Chorus]
It is the smallest of all seeds
But when it has grown it becomes a tree
So that the birds of the air come
And nest in its branches

[Verse]
Rain comes down and sun comes round
Little shoot pokes from the ground
Bigger, bigger, branch and leaf
God's kingdom grows beyond belief

[Chorus]
It is the smallest of all seeds
But when it has grown it becomes a tree
So that the birds of the air come
And nest in its branches

[Bridge]
Little faith, little hand
Little kindness, little plan
God can take the smallest thing
And make the whole world sing

[Outro]
The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed
A mustard seed
